routeAdjustment: Use pinned Ostrowski classification and native normalized-order uniqueness. Use pinned polynomial maximal root factorization, split root products and reduced rational numerator/denominator. Prove only reciprocity with X; after choosing the second nonconstant function as coordinate, this suffices for norm transfer. It avoids porting the external full arbitrary-pair rational reciprocity induction and its duplicate place normalization.
discharged: Actual Weil reciprocity with the rational coordinate X is proved for every nonzero rational function whose divisor avoids zero and infinity. The actual place census, normalized point orders, finite and infinity residues, principal-divisor formulas, root multiplicities, root products and numerator/denominator nonvanishing are derived, not assumed. This closes the rational-coordinate calculation required by the original finite norm-transfer route. That transfer, pairing descent and nondegeneracy, Hecke adjointness, Frobenius determinant, residual association, automorphy and all-weight continuation remain required. DUB-17--20 OPEN; 16/20.
remaining: Construct the finite rational-coordinate map into the original modular function field and apply actual norm/pullback and pushforward evaluation formulas. Their original-to-original specializations do not directly typecheck for a RatFunc base: a narrow RatFunc-to-original consumer must use the proved generic field-norm and divisor formulas. Constant second functions use existing principal-divisor degree zero. Pairing descent, nondegeneracy and determinant remain separate. Scratch only; production promotion and assembled verification pending. No additional acceptance gate closes. DUB-17--20 OPEN; 16/20.
